# Revision 9: the security category as an input, counting convention EVERY t (generated by `uv run yugen-soundness --rev7`)

Tree of 20,000 proofs; union bound; no grinding; unique decoding for certified rows; true rates; spBCS (Sharp-Grubbs, ePrint 2026/2615, Theorem 6.6). Sizes are estimates (E) anchored on measured proofs (M): A's masked leaf 688,180 B (row 6, 64-byte salts), A's node 875,309 B, B's form-T leaf 583,680 B (32-byte salts), B's node 538,272 B (2^23 words); non-opening bytes scale with the field's element size.

## Derivation of the targets from NIST-CfP Section 4.A.5 (pages 16 to 18)

| Category | NIST's requirement (reference attack) | Classical gates (p. 18) | Quantum gates x MAXDEPTH (p. 18) | kappa_C (oracle calls) | Gates an evaluation implied | Grover overhead implied | kappa_Q | G a round | Digest, attack rule | Digest, proven rule | Book need, A (k = 599; non-default) | Book need, B (k = 600; non-default) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | key search on AES128 | 2^143 | 2^170 | 128 | 2^15 | 2^42 | 64 | 128 | 256 | 264 | 152.52 | 152.52 |
| 2 | collision search on SHA256/ SHA3-256 | 2^146 | not given | 128 | 2^18 | - | 64 | 128 | 256 | 264 | 152.52 | 152.52 |
| 3 | key search on AES192 | 2^207 | 2^233 | 192 | 2^15 | 2^41 | 96 | 192 | 384 | 392 | 216.52 | 216.52 |
| 4 | collision search on SHA384/ SHA3-384 | 2^210 | not given | 192 | 2^18 | - | 96 | 192 | 384 | 392 | 216.52 | 216.52 |
| 5 | key search on AES 256 | 2^272 | 2^298 | 256 | 2^16 | 2^42 | 128 | 256 | 512 | 520 | 280.52 | 280.52 |

Revision 9: the last two columns are the book's needs, NON-DEFAULT (t >= k_q). The default need (every t) is kappa_C + 1 + log2 N + log2(1 + k_q) at each row's own k_q (SG26 Theorem 6.6 (2), Definitions H.3, H.4; docs/decision-qrom-counting.md): 157.0 to 158.8 bits at category 1, printed with each row.

Condition Q's per-round need (Theorem 6.6 (2) IOP term, C1 = 6, N = 20,000): cat1 145.87; cat2 145.87; cat3 209.87; cat4 209.87; cat5 273.87 bits; condition C binds at every category.

## cat1 (as built: D-b salts, SQ-48 BLAKE3): digest 256 bits, salts 64 B (proof) / 64 B (leaf), GF(2^256), tree hashes Keccak-256 (A) / BLAKE3 (B)

## Salt floors from a zero-knowledge target (pool of 2^20 leaf proofs; each figure excludes Q eps_hvzk)

Leaf salt floor: the leaf term alone (independent of t). Proof salt floor: the salt term at t = 2^kappa_Q of the privacy category (t counts hash queries before the last proof; Theorem 6.6 (3)).

| Pool target | Leaf salt, b = 32 (A / B) | b = 48 (A / B) | b = 64 (A / B) | Proof salt, t = 2^64 | t = 2^96 | t = 2^128 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2^-64 | 59 / 59 | 75 / 75 | 91 / 91 | 38 | 46 | 54 |
| 2^-96 | 67 / 67 | 83 / 83 | 99 / 99 | 46 | 54 | 62 |
| 2^-128 | 75 / 75 | 91 / 91 | 107 / 107 | 54 | 62 | 70 |

Counts (n_pos, leaf bytes) are category 1's; at larger counts n_pos changes by under one bit (leaf salt floors move by at most one byte).

## Revision 9: system B's rows with every Johnson-regime term (category 1, GF(2^256))

Counting convention: EVERY t (the default; Sharp-Grubbs ePrint 2026/2615 Theorem 6.6 (2) with Definitions H.3, H.4; docs/decision-qrom-counting.md): need = kappa_C + 1 + log2 N + log2(1 + k_q) at each row's own k_q, solved to its fixed point.

Every Johnson-regime row rests on DKT26 (Dao, Kominers, Thaler, ePrint 2026/2056), a PREPRINT; it is never printed as certified without this label. Unique-decoding rows use no Johnson-regime statement. The rate-1/4 Johnson row: arithmetic only: no lemma stated or refereed at this rate, no build (finding R8-3).

### Refusals (hard failures, `OutsideRegime`)

- a fold line of message dimension 1 without Lemma 3.3: refused: node at rate 1/8: X fold 28 has message dimension 1 (log_terminal_dim = 0); DKT26 Theorem 4.4 excludes D = 0. Add DKT26 Lemma 3.3's term (dimension_one='lemma33') or choose log_terminal_dim >= 1
- Haboeck's route: refused: Haboeck's route is not available for system B as built (binius-johnson-row.md 0.1: gaps G-1, G-3, G-6); only 'ud' and 'dkt' are computed
- m = 2: refused: m = 2 < 3: outside the Johnson regime of binius-johnson-row.md 2.2 (and DKT26 (36) m >= 3)
- m missing: refused: the Johnson regime needs m
- m not an integer: refused: m = 10.0: the Johnson parameter must be an integer >= 3
- D > n - 2: refused: D = 15 > n - 2 = 14: outside DKT26 Theorem 4.4's hypothesis 1 <= D <= n - 2
- log_terminal_dim above the message log: refused: log_terminal_dim = 29: outside 0 .. 28 (the message log2 of the node's largest level)
- log_terminal_dim negative: refused: log_terminal_dim = -1: outside 0 .. 28 (the message log2 of the node's largest level)
- a Johnson threshold above the unique-decoding one (m = 1 is refused first; rate 1/2, m = 3): refused: m = 3, rate 1/2: the Johnson threshold (1 + 1/(2m)) sqrt(rho) is not below the unique-decoding threshold (1 + rho)/2
- the same node with DKT26 Lemma 3.3 added: X fold 28 (message dimension 1): count 52, 250.30 bits
